title: Disputed Draws and Draw Reversals on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Blocks
content:
A client may dispute a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours draw it believes was mistaken or over-converted.

## Conditions for a reversal

| Condition | Record that shows it |
|---|---|
| The dispute is raised within the size's dispute window, in calendar days after the draw's entry date | the draw's entry date on the block's hours ledger |
| The draw has not already been reversed; a draw is reversed at most once | the block's hours ledger, which shows any earlier reversal of that draw |
| The hours restored do not exceed the hours of that draw | the draw's own hours |
| The block the draw was taken from has the status active or depleted when the reversal is posted | the block's own record |

## Counting the window

The window is counted in calendar days from the draw's entry date, that date being day 0, and a dispute raised on the last day is in time. Hypothetical cases on a 30-day window for a draw dated 1 March: a dispute raised on 31 March (day 30) is in time; one raised on 1 April (day 31) is not.

## Effect

The reversal restores the hours to the block the draw was taken from. A depleted block that regains hours before its expiry date returns to active.

## Overage charges

Disputes about overage charges are invoice disputes handled by the accounting team, not reversals.
